limits: RSS values measure only the CLI process. This managed environment omits /proc/PID/task/PID/children even for a live owned child; no decoder-descendant or aggregate peak is claimed. Sampling every25ms can miss brief peaks.

limits: The archive contains private credential hashes and personal records, is unencrypted, and cannot recreate missing raw private links. Checksums are integrity checks, not participant-history authentication.
Restoration pauses the stored checkpoint, not necessarily the last audible position. A previously playing revision increments once; paused revisions remain unchanged.
Linux-only source locking, /proc pinned access and renameat2 no-replace; existing destinations are never merged or replaced. Nonempty WAL/journal and unreferenced media reject without repair.
Safe receipts and descriptor-based cleanup are not an arbitrary malicious same-UID filesystem sandbox. Complete published output is preserved and reported if final directory durability sync fails.
The five-minute command limit includes all media checks. This measured machine passed; slower machines may reject valid maximum libraries without partial publication.
No new transcription/separation/musical quality, original-upload losslessness, hardware audio timing, multi-device synchronization or remote deployment claim.
